critical_infrastructure_gap.finding: The frontend has zero test infrastructure: no vitest/jest, no @testing-library/react, no jsdom, no src/**/*.test.jsx anywhere in the repo. Root package.json devDependencies are only vite/@vitejs/plugin-react/oxlint/@types. Backend has its own runner (node --test) but that is irrelevant to frontend coverage.
critical_infrastructure_gap.why_it_matters: frontend.md mandates React Testing Library for every interactive component, and CLAUDE.md §9.4 fails the gate if coverage < 70%. Zero frontend infra means the Test Script Writer (stage 6) cannot produce runnable tests, and the Tester (stage 7) cannot execute anything, until a runner exists.
required_before_stage_6: Add vitest.config.js (or extend vite.config.js test block) with environment: 'jsdom' and a setup file importing @testing-library/jest-dom
Add a 'test' script to root package.json: 'vitest run' (and 'test:watch': 'vitest')
CSS Modules import handling needs no extra config under Vite/vitest (class-name objects resolve automatically).
critical_infrastructure_gap.ownership: This is plumbing, not a design/architecture decision (no competing approach to choose between, single well-established toolchain matching Vite+React 19), so it does not require another architecture-review round. Flagging it here as a hard prerequisite the Test Script Writer stage must satisfy as its first action, since no prior stage installed it and stage 4.15/4.16 correctly scoped it out as backend-only.

unit_vs_integration_boundary.principle: Unit tests isolate pure logic and single components with mocked collaborators. Integration tests exercise a component tree as a user would (render + interact via Testing Library, querying by role/label per frontend.md), crossing real child-component boundaries but mocking the network edge.
unit_scope: src/lib/navigation.js — NAV_ITEMS shape and APP_SHELL_HASHES derivation (pure data, no rendering)
src/hooks/useCurrentUser.js — returns the mock object unchanged (trivial hook, still gets one direct test since it's the seam future real-auth replaces)
AppShell's resolveInitialViewId behavior — covered as a unit-level concern via AppShell's own render tests (not exported, so tested through its observable behavior rather than imported directly)
integration_scope: AppShell — full render: initial view resolution from a valid hash, from an invalid/missing hash (fallback to first NAV_ITEMS entry), Sidebar selection switching TopBar title and content region, skip-link presence and target id
Sidebar — render of items, aria-current on the active item, onSelect fired with correct id on click, keyboard activation (Enter/Space on the nav buttons)
TopBar — renders title text and mounts UserBadge (no user prop passed/needed — locks in AC-5)
UserBadge — renders name/role/initials sourced from useCurrentUser()

App.jsx — the outermost ternary: an app-shell hash renders AppShell alone (Header/Footer absent from the DOM — locks in AC-1); a non-app-shell hash (including '') renders the marketing tree (Header + Hero/ServicesSection/DeliveryCenters + Footer) with AppShell absent

MasterDataTable — loading state (role=status/aria-live=polite), error state (role=alert) with the useMasterDataTable hook mocked (not the network), and success rendering with mocked data rows including the zero-rows empty-state message
explicitly_out_of_scope_for_this_feature: useMasterDataTable's own fetch/cancellation logic — pre-existing, untouched by this feature, already implicitly covered by any prior MasterDataTable tests; no new tests required here since CLAUDE.md §1 Minimal Impact means this stage doesn't retrofit coverage onto unrelated untouched code
masterDataApi.js network layer — untouched by this feature
Marketing components (Hero/ServicesSection/DeliveryCenters) content — untouched by this feature; only their presence/absence at the App.jsx routing boundary is in scope

mock_strategy.network: Mock at the hook boundary, not fetch/MSW: MasterDataTable tests mock useMasterDataTable's return value directly (vi.mock('../../hooks/useMasterDataTable')) to assert the three states (loading/error/success) deterministically without timers or network shims. This matches the existing hook contract ({data, isLoading, error}) and avoids introducing a network-mocking dependency (MSW) that no other rule file calls for.
mock_strategy.current_user: useCurrentUser is NOT mocked in UserBadge's own test (it's synchronous and trivial — exercise it for real). It MAY be mocked in AppShell/TopBar integration tests if UserBadge's rendering is irrelevant noise to the assertion being made; prefer exercising it for real when practical since it adds no flakiness risk (pure sync mock data).
mock_strategy.routing: useLocationHash is exercised for real in App.jsx tests by setting window.location.hash before render and calling location.hash = '' between cases (jsdom supports this natively) rather than mocking the hook, since hash-routing behavior is exactly what AC-1 needs verified end-to-end.
mock_strategy.no_snapshot_tests: Per frontend.md, snapshot tests are banned — all assertions are behavior/DOM-query based (getByRole, getByText, getByLabelText).

coverage_plan.gate_threshold: 70% (CLAUDE.md §9.4, test-writer gate agent) computed over this feature's new/changed files only, consistent with how prior stages scoped their own audits to the feature's file set
coverage_plan.expected_coverage: Comfortably above 70% for every listed file: each is small, has no untested branches beyond the ones enumerated in integration_scope above (initial-hash resolution fallback, active/inactive nav-item styling, loading/error/success/empty states), and none contain dead branches per code-simplifier's stage 4.8 audit.
coverage_plan.risk_if_skipped: Without the vitest/RTL install (see critical_infrastructure_gap), coverage is mechanically 0% for all of the above, which is an automatic FAIL on the test-writer gate agent per CLAUDE.md §9.5 — this would BLOCK the merge-to-main gate regardless of code quality, independent of any functional defect.

handoff_to_stage_6_test_script_writer.must_do_first: Install and configure the vitest/RTL toolchain listed under critical_infrastructure_gap before writing any test file.
handoff_to_stage_6_test_script_writer.then: Write one *.test.jsx per component/module in in_scope_files_for_coverage, co-located per frontend.md (e.g. src/components/AppShell/AppShell.test.jsx), following the unit/integration boundaries and mock strategy above.
handoff_to_stage_6_test_script_writer.acceptance_criteria_source: tasks/agent-outputs/business-analyst/FEAT-1.json REQ-1..REQ-5 acceptance criteria, cross-referenced against AC-1/AC-5/AC-6 resolutions confirmed by every stage from solution-architect (round 2) through code-simplifier.
